subject: Technical walkthrough & evaluation launch — next steps and calendar
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + propose slots for technical walkthrough and eval launch

Hi Samantha / Liam —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Quick recap and suggested next steps to get the evaluation (pilot) rolling: 

Summary from our call: 
- Use case: embed clinical notes + triage assistant to surface recommended actions (priority: accuracy on medication fields and entity extraction).
- Target users: triage nurses and case managers (~30 active users in pilot).
- Primary constraints: PII handling, <200ms avg generation latency target for short prompts, and SOC2 compliance.

Proposed next meeting (technical walkthrough + evaluation launch): please pick one of the options below — this will be a 60-minute session to align scope, agree success criteria, and hand over prompt/test data.
- Option A: Wed Jun 6, 10:00–11:00 AM ET
- Option B: Thu Jun 7, 2:00–3:00 PM ET

Pre-work requested (we can proceed without all items but the meeting will be more effective if you can share these by EOD Tue Jun 4):
- 10–20 representative prompts (anonymized) + 2 sample clinical notes (PII redacted) — csv or txt is fine
- A short list of 3 success metrics (e.g., exact match on medication ORM, top-1 entity accuracy, average tokens generated)
- SSO/SAML contact or whether you want us to demo without SSO

Attachments I've included: eval-charter-template.pdf (draft mutual action plan) and prompt-sample.csv (example prompt formatting).

Agenda for the walkthrough (proposed):
1) 10m — Goals & success criteria alignment
2) 20m — Technical architecture: how Redwood handles inference, data residency, and access
3) 20m — Prompt set + evaluation harness and what we need from your side
4) 10m — Logistics, timeline, and next steps (DocuSign/procurement touchpoints)

If either slot works, I'll lock it and send a calendar invite with a short Zoom and a manganese (internal) runbook for attendees.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to a hands-on trial.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
